subject: Linguistics
title: Language and the Internet
description: A quick, practical guide to Language and the Internet.

hook.text: 'lol,' 'brb,' 'slay'—the internet created a new layer of language faster than any force in history.

buildup.text: Online communication blends speech and writing, creating a new mode linguists call 'netspeak.'

discovery.text: Emoji, memes, and hashtags function as linguistic tools—carrying meaning, irony, and social identity.

twist.text: Internet language evolves so rapidly that a word can go from cool to outdated in months.

climax.text: The internet hasn't ruined language—it's expanded it into new and creative domains.

punchline.text: The internet didn't break language—it gave it new playgrounds.

quiz.question: How has the internet affected language?
options: Created new modes blending speech and writing
